recentItems.title: Throwback: How Yayoi Kusama captured the hearts of art lovers
recentItems.description:
Renowned contemporary artist Yayoi Kusama — known for her mesmerizing polka dot installations — has died at 97. 

In 2017, CBC’s Paul Hunter toured Washington’s Hirshhorn Museum, where art lovers were treated to immersive experiences inside the artist's Infinity Rooms.

recentItems.description:

CBC’s senior business reporter Peter Armstrong breaks down the sectors that contributed to Canada’s economic gains.
